name: edumap-platform
description: EduMap AI Educational Closed-Loop Ecosystem - Dual Portals for Teachers & Students

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,TEACHER,STUDENT" -c "blue.bold,green.bold,magenta.bold" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend/teacher-portal-frontend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend/student-frontend run dev"
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix frontend/student-frontend run build && npm --prefix frontend/teacher-portal-frontend run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend/teacher-portal-frontend install && npm --prefix frontend/student-frontend install
